cross_finding_reconciliation.decision: Implement one shared D1/D2 responsive-sheet and D5 route-adapter contract, while preserving feature-specific IDs and local loading requirements.
Apply the universal D4 dismissal guard to every close path; Daily Logging additionally must flush or confirm pending auto-save writes.
